integrity: The proof of the global switch bound is analytical, and the explicit polynomial family proves attainment. Programmatic finite checks are supporting evidence only. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finitely supported de Finetti mixture with conditional iid truthful binary votes; no strategic voting, continuously supported environment, or nonexchangeable dependence claim. Some older dependent-voter literature was not available in full text.
title: A sharp support-size law for majority-accuracy reversals under shared information
